name: Szikszó (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Szikszó: a crowned blue shield with a white bird and a bunch of grapes, above a scroll inscribed SZIKSZÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szikszó arms with crown and scroll
